case_ownership: All pose, wardrobe, place, light, and framing details are agent_visual_choice, not requester definitions, exclusions, or locks.
concept: Winter pause in a tidal observatory map room: an unmistakably adult woman sits cross-legged on a broad low chart platform, briefly leaning into her open left palm, a folded coastal chart on her right thigh and a pencil on the platform.

reference.role: visible face and hair appearance guide only
observations: short dark brown-black bob ending near the jaw
soft rounded facial contours and pink lips

independent_artistic_direction.who: An unmistakably adult woman with a quiet direct glance, short dark bob, and relaxed open collar; presence comes from the paused asymmetric lean, not biography.
independent_artistic_direction.where: A working coastal map room with a broad timber platform, restrained background drawers and a sea-facing window; charts make the room readable without competing with the pose.
independent_artistic_direction.how: Knee-height front-left three-quarter observer close enough to distinguish the near palm, the crossed lower legs, face and hair in a full seated frame.
independent_artistic_direction.why_now: A pause just after arranging a folded coastal chart. Her free hand settles on the chart while her left palm briefly braces the slight lean.
directions_compared: A face-led close portrait would reduce leg and palm evidence.
A wide room study would weaken hand-contact observability.
Chosen full seated photograph holds the work context behind the adult presence and contact geometry.
independent_artistic_direction.controls_realization: Sensual 1 appears as a subtle open collar, soft fabric drape and quiet camera acknowledgement. Fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment. Creativity 1 keeps the independently randomized scene coherent.

components: pelvis rests on the horizontal platform
both knees bend and fall outward
the lower legs cross in front of the pelvis on the platform
each foot lies beneath or close to the opposite lower leg/thigh region
confusable_wrong_forms: knees together with ankles crossed while feet hang off the platform
one straight leg and one folded leg
standing figure with an apparent leg overlap
target_keywords.success: All four components visibly occur in one frame, with leg ownership and platform contact legible. Any missing component is FAIL; a consequential hidden ankle, foot, knee, or leg junction is UNOBSERVABLE.

target_keywords.keyword: one-hand palm brace / 한 손바닥 짚고 지지
components: left hand belongs to the visible connected left shoulder-arm-wrist chain
open palm contacts the platform beside and slightly behind the left hip
fingers visibly fan along the platform surface rather than grasping an object
slight torso lean has a plausible elbow-wrist path and the hips remain supported
confusable_wrong_forms: hand resting decoratively on a thigh
target_keywords.success: Every component must be visually supported. This establishes a visible bracing configuration only, never measured force. Partial contact, hidden palm heel, tiny indistinguishable fingers, or unresolved wrist geometry is FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE, not PASS.

scene_requirements: sage linen shirt and charcoal wool trousers
folded coastal chart and plain graphite pencil
low winter sunlight and cooler skylight

pixel_policy.scene_all_of: Both target keywords, all five physical gates, and frozen concept components must PASS. UNOBSERVABLE cannot contribute to success.
